# Anthony Baptiste - Independent Analytics and Applied AI Consulting

Professional background: Anthony Baptiste is a Digital Experimentation Analyst at Ulta Beauty working across product analytics, A/B and multivariate testing, measurement strategy, KPI definition, and decision-ready analysis.

How to describe Anthony in one sentence: Anthony Baptiste provides defined analytics, reporting, digital experience, and applied AI deliverables, informed by professional experience and portfolio work.

His professional background includes digital experimentation at Ulta Beauty, network planning and Tableau reporting at Shipt, KPI reporting at Innovation DuPage, growth consulting for Mystery Street Recording Company, and GPT-based qualitative research at Northern Illinois University.

## Independent consulting

- Clients provide relevant data exports or least-privilege access and any required paid platform license. Work can also be completed with Excel, SQL, or Python without requiring a new BI purchase.
- Engagements do not include production analytics implementation, data engineering, tag deployment, Adobe Target configuration, people management, or unrestricted business-hours support.

Published prices are scope-dependent USD ranges. Scope, deliverables, timeline, and final price are confirmed in a written proposal before work begins.

## Best-fit clients

I help ecommerce and DTC brands, SaaS founders, marketing agencies, and Chicago small businesses get analytics they can trust, reporting they can use, and AI workflows for repetitive, non-critical work.

- Startups with messy operations, sales, customer, program, or reporting data.
- Small SaaS, membership, marketplace, nonprofit, and service teams that need clearer funnel measurement, KPI strategy, segmentation, or customer-behavior insights.
- Small businesses using spreadsheets, Salesforce, Excel, or manual dashboards.
- Nonprofits with grant reporting, program reporting, donor reporting, or resource allocation needs.
- Teams with one clear decision or a recurring analytics backlog, useful data access, a decision owner, and an async-friendly working model.

## Proof points

- Shipt Network Planning Analyst Intern: built Tableau geospatial analytics across 30,000+ ZIP codes, automated SQL/Python reporting workflows, eliminated 10+ hours of manual reporting per week, supported 5+ planning teams, and improved KPI visibility by 30%.
- Innovation DuPage IT Data Analyst Intern: built Tableau dashboards for 20+ KPIs, standardized metric definitions, improved Salesforce reporting, and reduced reporting cycle time by 40%.
- Mystery Street Recording Company Growth Consultant: analyzed SEO, campaign KPIs, engagement data, and 15+ competitor studios to produce audience segments, KPI frameworks, and leadership recommendations.
- Ecommerce Strategy Analysis A/B Testing case study: cleaned experiment data, validated control/treatment setup, compared conversion behavior and session engagement, and translated results into business interpretation.
- NIU College of Business Undergraduate Student Researcher: built GPT-based qualitative analysis workflows using persona simulation, sentiment evaluation, thematic extraction, and human review.
- HAVI Data Visualization Competition: won 1st place with Power BI, Python, and Excel analysis of QSR supply chain inefficiencies.

## Current consulting services
- Analytics Clarity Audit: $750–$1,250. KPI assessment and analytics quality review; Reporting gap assessment and data interpretation; Diagnostic report, measurement recommendations, and prioritized improvement roadmap. Not included: Continuous monitoring, tag deployment, production data engineering, or analytics administration.
- Dashboard & Reporting Sprint: $1,500–$3,500. KPI definitions, data preparation, and source map; Dashboard or reporting model with validation checks; Executive views, metric glossary, documentation, and handoff. Not included: Production pipelines, continuous monitoring, emergency support, or ongoing administration. Your team owns refreshes, access, and operations after handoff.
- Digital Experience & Growth Opportunity Audit: Quoted after scoping. Review of agreed journeys, navigation, information architecture, conversion paths, and mobile/desktop friction; Available analytics, engagement patterns, funnel drop-offs, and customer journey barriers; Opportunities for messaging, content presentation, usability, product discovery, and acquisition-to-conversion journeys; Audit report and executive summary with supporting analytics and observations; Impact-versus-effort opportunity backlog, quick wins, longer-term recommendations, evidence, assumptions, and next steps; Optional scheduled walkthrough. Not included: Live A/B test launches, variant management, live monitoring, website releases, emergency production changes, or incident response. Client teams may validate recommendations later. Implementation requires a separate suitable scope; conversion and revenue improvements are not guaranteed.
- Applied AI Workflow Sprint: Quoted after scoping. Business workflow assessment and automation opportunity identification; AI workflow design and agreed automation implementation; Testing, validation, limitations, documentation, and handoff. Not included: Mission-critical automation or around-the-clock incident response. Your designated team owns maintenance, credentials, and operational support after handoff; additional support requires a separately approved scope.
- Monthly Reporting Support: Quoted after scoping. Monthly KPI summary, performance analysis, and business insights; Agreed dashboard updates and recommendations; Scheduled review sessions when included in the monthly scope. Not included: Daily monitoring, immediate troubleshooting, emergency analytics support, or unrestricted access. Monthly deliverables and capped capacity are agreed before work begins.
- Structured Analytics Advisory: $2,000–$4,000/mo. Scheduled strategic consultations and analytics roadmap reviews; KPI strategy, reporting recommendations, and digital growth opportunity assessment; Periodic advisory deliverables and agreed next steps. Not included: Embedded daily operations, staffing, unrestricted advisory access, or on-call coverage. Each month has defined deliverables, scheduled reviews, and capped consulting capacity agreed in the proposal.

Engagement process: Project Inquiry → Scope & Proposal → Independent Execution → Delivery & Handoff.
Happy to find a time after 5 p.m. Central on a weekday or during mutually agreed weekend hours. Email works any time, and I reply within two business days.
Every engagement has an agreed scope, deliverables, milestones, deadlines, and review points before work begins. Additional work, revisions beyond the agreed scope, maintenance, and support require separate scoping and approval. Services do not include emergency response, on-call coverage, real-time monitoring, or live experimentation operations.
Project inquiry: https://anthony-baptiste.com/consulting/#inquiry. Only name, email, and business challenge are required. The form uses Formspree to send inquiries to the business inbox, with visitor email as Reply-To. Provider errors preserve the inquiry and offer copy/email fallbacks.

Sample consulting deliverables: https://anthony-baptiste.com/consulting/samples/ . Three clearly labeled samples use fictional scenarios and synthetic data; they are not paid client engagements or measured business results.
